review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Extent 0x004E7530-0x004E7535, 6 bytes, 2 instructions a1 c8885400 / c3; the byte tiling sums to the extent exactly (section 20 triage row).

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: One block, zero edges on both sides; a 1/0 shape is correct for a two-instruction getter.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: No argument read and no stack access; the function reads one absolute dword.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: No call and no store: the only effect is the EAX value left for callers.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Single data address 0x005488C8; the retail image holds 255 there, so the storage is initialised to 0xFF rather than zero.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Emitted listing: mov 0x567038,%eax ; ret - same load-then-return shape and same 6-byte size as retail.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Retail's EAX carries the loaded dword and callers may consume it, so the candidate returns std::uint32_t instead of discarding the value.

limitations: Static only; no runtime observation, and the native sits behind the 0x00402930 boundary.
Retail symbol unknown; the name carries the address suffix as an unverified placeholder, and the candidate label StatusScreen_GetEvent is not used because it is unverified.
The meaning of the word at 0x005488C8 is not established, and no writer of it has been identified among the transcribed natives.
